title: Reunite
summary: REUNI'TE, verb transitive [re and unite.] 1. To unite again; to join after separation. 2. In medicine, union of parts separated by wounds or accidents. REUNI'TE, verb intransitive To be united again;

inlines.v: REUNI'TE, verb transitive [re and unite.] 1. To unite again; to join after separation. 2. In medicine, union of parts separated by wounds or accidents. REUNI'TE, verb intransitive To be united again; to join and cohere again.
